Resolves #19832

Content-sized rows now have CI coverage for rows sized by a locked column, at both ends of the grid. A new component fixture, `grid-locked-wrap`, constructs one grid with three wrapped columns: one locked to the start, one in the center and one locked to the end. Its records rotate which of the three holds the long text. `LockedWrapRows.spec.mjs` asserts in a real browser that each region holds the tallest text of some rendered rows, and that every row is as tall as that text in all three bodies, on the first screen and after a scroll. Test-only: no engine change, and `grid-wrap-text` with its two specs stays untouched.

Evidence: L3 (a real browser on the component fixture, with two mutations of `grid.View`'s measurement and a five-family font sweep) → L3 required (AC-2 and AC-3 are browser-layout outcomes). Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit hooks ran. Change class: zero-delta (`test`).
Prescription checked: `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-wrap-text/` was the candidate to extend. Better owner: a new fixture. `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` asserts timing- and geometry-sensitive behaviour on `grid-wrap-text`'s current columns, and `grid-two-views` imports its store.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-locked-wrap/app.mjs`: `lead` locked start, `text` center, `note` locked end, all `wrapText`. In the five-family font sweep, 4 to 6 first-screen rows per region (1200×800) take their height from that region, and the spec asserts at least one per region |
| AC-2 | `LockedWrapRows.spec.mjs` › "a row is as tall as its tallest wrapped text in any region, in all three bodies", and › "rows that mount on a scroll are sized the same way" |
| AC-3 | outside CI, mutations of `src/grid/View.mjs` on both measuring paths, `getMeasureColumns` (premeasurement) and `measureRowHeights` (mounted): without `bodyEnd`, both arms are red ("record 3 (tallest: end): 32 vs 81"); without `bodyStart`, both are red ("record 1 (tallest: start): 32 vs 43"). Green on `dev` |
| AC-4 | `WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs` and `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` are unchanged in the diff. WrapTextMeasure passes beside the new spec |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The mutations showed the existing gap directly: without `bodyEnd`, all three `WrapTextMeasure` tests stayed green. Without `bodyStart`, its first-screen test stayed green and only its scroll test went red.

## Test Evidence
- **Mutations** (AC-3 above), each reverted; `git diff -- src/` is empty at the head.
- **Font sweep** (local probe, families injected before the app boots, since Arial approximates Linux CI's metrics). Arial, Georgia, Verdana, Courier New and Times New Roman each gave 4 to 6 rows sized per region, with 0 misfits.
- `LockedWrapRows.spec.mjs` and `WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs` pass locally under the e2e config. All other coverage runs in CI.
